source.transcription_method: Direct extraction from the PDF text layer using the printed table column positions; no external standards data was used and blank cells were not filled.
source.review_notice: Catalogue transcription for implementation reference. Preserve source values; user and engineer will independently verify before engineering use.
transcription_notes: NPS 44 row is visually split in the PDF text layer; its values were transcribed from the same page table and inserted explicitly.
Blank schedule cells are omitted rather than inferred or filled from external sources.
Values are strings to preserve the catalogue's printed decimal precision.
